precedence: Overrides only B0/Primary CatBoost categorical feature-role assignment. All feature sets, feature order, hyperparameters, folds, targets, EB, PL, gates, bootstrap and floors remain unchanged.

categorical_preprocessing.rule: For categorical columns only: replace missing/null with __MISSING__, then cast to string. Existing __MISSING__ remains __MISSING__. No category re-encoding, ordinal mapping, frequency encoding or one-hot encoding is permitted.
categorical_preprocessing.catboost_cat_features_argument: Pass the exact feature names, not inferred dtype positions.

numeric_preprocessing.cast_rule: All non-categorical model features must be numeric-compatible; do not stringify them.

forbidden_role_changes: Do not treat calendar_month or day_of_week as CatBoost categorical.
Do not treat frame_number or horse_number as CatBoost categorical.
Do not treat binary flags as CatBoost categorical.
Do not include class_group_no in Primary at all.
Do not auto-detect categorical columns from pandas dtype.
Do not add categorical columns after seeing fit/evaluation results.
